guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess whether a target property is per-atom or per-image and if it is intensive or extensive
target_per_atom: check if a target property scales per-atom by comparing the first dimension to atom counts
target_extensive: determine if a property is extensive by checking if per-atom normalized values have low variation
target_constant_shape: check if all target samples have the same shape regardless of the number of atoms
